page.overview:
Who is Gus?

Gus acted as a security system for Depot 12, but he was considered ineffective. Knowing that the Spice Miners' Guild would shut them down if the next inspection did not go well, Duv Dennick and Franklin Munt elected to replace him with the automaton, Gary.
